preflight_issue_readbacks.title: Sting dev seat: adoption, estate migration and operating guards
preflight_issue_readbacks.description:
## Outcome

Sting is the intended daily remote development seat. Complete and preserve the real edit → signed commit → push → PR → review workflow alongside working SSH, tmux/cmux and eGreg. Neo can keep running concurrent work; it is not frozen for a ceremony.

## Adoption evidence

The 2026-08-31 receipt in comment `f357b473-6456-4afd-bf92-089a7a22bf28` records all three measured criteria: LAN interactive login, continuously alive `main`, and Sting-produced signed PR [tinyland-inc/lab#1595](https://linear.app/tinyland/review/docssting-support-live-migration-and-retire-ceremony-gates-c34185263808). Review and merge remained outstanding at that receipt.

The 2026-09-12 takeover confirms existing `main` and `egreg-lab` sessions at `/tmp/tmux-1000/default`. The current CLI default socket differs; attach the existing server rather than interpreting the other socket's absence as session loss. Current unqualified `who` is empty, so no new interactive-login receipt is asserted.

## Remaining closure

Lab [tinyland-inc/lab#1595](https://linear.app/tinyland/review/docssting-support-live-migration-and-retire-ceremony-gates-c34185263808) merged through normal protections at 2026-09-13T00:44:10Z, merge commit `1d8079fb0b88082fbd0f846404a5166e19bf1c57`: [tinyland-inc/lab#1595](https://linear.app/tinyland/review/docssting-support-live-migration-and-retire-ceremony-gates-c34185263808). The September repair removes superseded stillness, exclusion and stop-writer prose and its literal test assertions. Runtime continuity and full-state coverage remain distinct from this completed documentation merge.

The September carry has placed eleven additional home trees on `/srv/fast-local` with home symlinks. Recovered Codex history is preserved in a standalone SQLite snapshot under `state/provider-snapshots/neo/20260909T093450Z`. The separately reviewed state_5 insert-only/path-update adapter has now completed live integration; recovered thread-history composition remains offline. The operator authorized treating `ems-jess-dev-wt` as archival payload: its broken `.git` pointer was removed on both hosts, with payload preserved. Live state_5 integration is complete; the recovered thread-history candidate remains preserved offline.

C2 auto-fire is disarmed by `d721a04a` and its amendments; the expired August deadline never triggers a reframe or session shutdown. The obsolete C2 execution blocks and queue sequence have been removed from this description. Prior observations and ratifications remain in comments. [TIN-3080](https://linear.app/tinyland/issue/TIN-3080/relocate-egreg-emacs-daemon-honeysting-new-e)'s eGreg disposition follows its own completion record; historical storage incidents do not impose an unratified avoidance of `/srv/fast-local`.

## Configuration reconciliation receipt

Eight copied configuration links targeted a Neo-only Nix store generation absent on Sting. No corresponding files existed in Sting's active Home Manager generation. Repaired cmux, ghostty, linear-gsuite, the explicitly Neo-named storage registry, and four tinyland/vscode links to their preserved resolved incoming files under `/srv/fast-local/jess/state/config-carry/neo-20260912/resolved`; original link definitions remain in `source-links`. No readable native managed setting was overwritten. The fish 4.3 migration file had an empty `fish_key_bindings`; restored `fish_default_key_bindings`, preserved the original in that same carry namespace, and verified a new interactive fish shell without the warning. Existing shells were not restarted.

The operator is beginning active work on Sting in spear_resumes and eGreg. Those workspaces remain dual-writer protected. `/home/jess` remains the login home; git/Claude/Codex/gstack resolve onto `/srv/fast-local`. `.config` and `.pi` remain on `/home`. Lab [tinyland-inc/lab#1595](https://linear.app/tinyland/review/docssting-support-live-migration-and-retire-ceremony-gates-c34185263808) is now merged through the normal protected process.

## eGreg parity gap — manual comparison

Operator manually fetched spear_resumes before the parity check; matching HEAD there does not prove migration delivery. eGreg was not at parity: Sting main4775fa6 was5 commits behind Neo mainff040f6 and42 behind active3617081, which Sting lacked. Neo lane-docs has1 changed path and lane-graph13, plus main .serena/project.yml. Eight registered Sting worktrees lack index files; three retain README payload and five do not. HEAD-resolution alone was insufficient prior acceptance.

Preserved all Neo eGreg refs in `/srv/fast-local/jess/state/git-carry/neo/eGreg/20260913/neo-egreg.bundle`, SHA256 `24eb80be2550e1f77729fbeabb698bf987e674aa015a2768d5c171de3805ff68`, and imported into separate `refs/carry/neo/20260913/*`. Native Sting HEAD remained4775fa6. This is object/ref custody, not active-checkout parity. All four current Neo eGreg checkouts have additionally been captured using the native Rust Git adapter and imported into neutral carry refs. Real Neo→Sting native transfer verified both bundle hashes: cold transferred 1,788,751 bytes from 1,886,317 source bytes; repeat reused both files with zero source reads or transfer. Current Neo checkout restoration is complete: `eGreg.worktrees/neo-active-20260913` plus `lane-console`, `lane-docs`, and `lane-graph`, all at 36170812ba41427e71614981b86f16d330229b4a. The native d4699b8 mover preserved their branch names and dirty state. Independently compared index-entry hashes and normalized staged/unstaged binary diffs against Neo: all match. All four reverse gitdir pointers verified and roots0700. Existing Sting main remains4775fa6. The eight historical worktrees now have reconstructed committed baselines under the operator's explicit approval. Original payload and administration are preserved under `state/git-carry/sting/eGreg/historical-baselines-20260913`; all eight baseline checks passed, active main and worktree registrations remained unchanged. Unknown original staging was not recovered or claimed recovered.

Remaining portable local-share payload: pnpm was absent on Sting. Preserved 101,585 regular files and 12 links (1,262,474,605 bytes including links) under `state/local-share-carry/neo-20260912/pnpm`, private root0700. This is preserved cache/tool payload, not activation of Darwin executables or Neo Nix-store launchers. TCFS registries list three noncolliding devices, but only Sting's input currently verifies cryptographically. Native self-import validates Sting's configured key and active registry; Neo's incoming registry fails signature verification. Neo's live file and carried copy have identical SHA256 `5390616319deeac2ee7cd47bd9c3c4a6dec121bad943baf94d6afe763e971c4e`, so the defect predates this carry. Signed and GitHub-verified commit `dbf9d26a959c2c12b0cefdcff07491ca25164827` provides a tested candidate-only native import command. Real candidate generation correctly refused; no signature bypass, rekeying, active registry replacement, or identity change occurred. A publication window alone does not resolve an invalid source signature.

`spear_resumes`: both main checkouts clean at148b9b52 after the operator's manual update. Recovered missing Neo branch `jess/tin-3750-hermetic-artifacts` atd052e410 on Sting via create-only ref update; bundle SHA256 `7e21394995e79ca529102dc57bf8029d2f599422b04fc9fa232647f575d8e036` retained in `state/git-carry/neo/spear_resumes/20260913/neo-heads.bundle`. Sting-only dirty `registry-default-20260813` captured by native d4699b8 with filesystem metadata; bundle SHA256 `83b81320764d95964215419cbec621bc71f12f3291fd8544537429d33f212989` retained in `state/git-carry/sting/spear_resumes/20260913/registry-default-capture/capture.bundle` and imported into Neo neutral `refs/carry/sting/20260913/registry-default/*`. Both working checkouts untouched. This repairs observed custody gaps without claiming estate-wide parity.

## Native transfer and provider validation

Native mover commit d4699b8 delivered and restored the four current eGreg worktrees. Four fresh bundles crossed Neo→Sting in8.91s (3,772,926 transferred bytes), warmrepeat0.28s with zero source reads/transfer; all hashes match. Larger sealed23-file corpus Sting→Neo acceptance transferred1,337,244,921bytes in135.69s from an already warmed source store, with zero original-source bytes reread. Repeat0.14s reused23files with zero wire/source bytes; all23SHA256 values match retained source hashes. A registered interruption test resumed after one committed file and completed remainingtwo without source rereads. These are measured directions/corpora, not an rclone comparison or a no-directory-rewalk claim.

Native hydration completed 6,708 files (415,480,447,268 output bytes), with compressed inputs retained and identities validated. The approved live state_5 adapter completed: 1,739 rows inserted, 10,248 paths corrected, zero runtime conflicts. Post-apply validation records 11,235 threads, unchanged schema and 52 migration records, zero foreign-key violations, and quick_check OK. All 114 historical missing-file records retain their original path pairs. Final Neo cutoff: 2026-09-13T01:03:30.434801059Z; later activity is not covered by this cutoff. Source snapshots and pre-apply backup hashes remain verified. Receipts: `/srv/fast-local/jess/state/provider-snapshots/sting/20260913-final-cutoff/`. No database file was replaced and no session stopped. Recovered-history composition remains offline: 266,352 records imported into the candidate, 506,729 existing items preserved, and 438 conflicting/orphan/control cases retained separately.

## Current operator decisions and estate scope

Operator explicitly chose to keep the invalid full Neo registry archived. Sting's active registry is unchanged; a separately recovered older `neo.local` subset verifies under the original signature, and its signed union candidate is retained but not activated. No rekeying or signature bypass is authorized. The later `macbook-neo` entry remains preserved but unverified.

Operator authorized preserving all existing files in the eight older eGreg worktrees and reconstructing their committed baselines. Existing files and administration must be retained before reconstruction; unknown original staging must not be represented as recovered. The four newly restored current Neo worktrees and active Sting main are outside that repair set.

Operator reiterated that eGreg is one of many repositories and full estate migration is required. Per-repository mover acceptance is not estate-wide coverage. Read-only repository/worktree comparison and bounded native batch execution are now in progress. Import-only custody must remain distinct from a usable restored workspace; active destination work must not be overwritten.

## Native estate acceptance — 2026-09-13

Completed and checked on Sting: 13 missing-index repairs, 24 ordinary absent worktrees restored, 1 retained-registration payload recovery ([TIN-1449](https://linear.app/tinyland/issue/TIN-1449/e5-observability-slos-per-tenant-dashboards-ttfch-probe-poison)), and 6 payload-only workspaces reattached. Captured HEADs, semantic indexes and reverse Git pointers were checked; active destination work remains untouched. These match recorded source snapshots, not later Neo commits. The two retained bulkload/DarwinNicUtil indexes recover dated staging, not unknown later staging. Other registered-payload recoveries remain in flight; a resolving HEAD alone is not payload completion.

Signed 562d277 includes configuration-aware standalone restoration, guarded retained-registration recovery and persistence timing instrumentation. 52 scoped tests, formatting, clippy and Linux/Darwin releases passed. Later source changes (streaming Git-object restoration, bounded persistence parallelism and directory durability) await integrated validation. Metadata censuses remain; no never-rewalk claim.

Measured comparison: isolated APFS-cloned 23-file corpus, 242,605,606 source bytes; local copy on Neo, nice19, one repetition per run, OS caches not flushed. Full BLAKE3 and mode/link checks ran outside timing. Instrumented run2: native initial 53,848.545 ms, 226,762,914 transferred content bytes; native resume 4.840 ms, zero source/content bytes. Actual rclone initial 1,082.360 ms, resume 141.069 ms; its byte counters are unmeasured. Native initial is about 49.75 times slower and resume about 29.15 times faster: not an overall performance win or a network benchmark. Chunk persistence measured 5,876 calls and 104.702 seconds summed worker time, including 35.135 seconds file sync and 31.734 seconds directory sync (5,743 each). Worker sums are not additive wall-time shares or isolated causal proof. Receipt: /Users/[host-local user redacted]/git/tummycrypt/.bulkload-bench-real-ee15653/run2-instrumented.log. Run1 remains retained beside it.

Not full-estate completion. Blahaj and some lab/GF restorations remain held on differing common info/exclude policies; no global policy edit occurred. Fresh configuration-aware Legalab and Medical captures completed and were delivered for restoration. Both source-change refusals from the 32-item pass succeeded on one bounded retry. The unchanged 103-item same-HEAD index capture plan is now running; its first seven captures were delivered. Chapel refused with GIT_INVENTORY_MALFORMED and is being investigated separately, not excluded. Original source captures continue without signals.

Recovered history remains offline pending explicit historical-restoration disposition: 3,511 turns and 262,043 items are absent from live history, all associated with currently live state5 thread IDs. No deletion tombstones exist, so first-import history cannot distinguish never-migrated rows from intentionally deleted rows. No history activation, projection-offset changes, database replacement or session stop occurred.

* opaque session and route handles; no token bytes cross the adapter boundary;
* lifecycle: preflight, managed launch, route/lease snapshot, typed transition, repair handoff, teardown;
* exact-model demand and one-alternate outcome vocabulary shared across adapters;
* feature/status discovery is explicit per method; unimplemented methods cannot advertise support;
* local-only redacted events and stable schema versioning;
* adapter-specific auth/provider mechanics stay behind the process boundary.

4. Only the versioned typed scalar extension namespace is tolerated; all other unknown or sensitive fields fail closed, and unsupported capabilities fail explicitly.
5. No C header, shared library, FFI ownership model, or raw credential response is shipped.

Phase-1 PR #475 declares the surface as `planned_unshipped` / `not_implemented`; it does not satisfy adapter round-trip or OpenCode acceptance.

issue_readbacks.description:
## Outcome

Sting is the intended daily remote development seat. Complete and preserve the real edit → signed commit → push → PR → review workflow alongside working SSH, tmux/cmux and eGreg. Neo can keep running concurrent work; it is not frozen for a ceremony.

## Adoption evidence

The 2026-08-31 receipt in comment `f357b473-6456-4afd-bf92-089a7a22bf28` records all three measured criteria: LAN interactive login, continuously alive `main`, and Sting-produced signed PR [tinyland-inc/lab#1595](https://linear.app/tinyland/review/docssting-support-live-migration-and-retire-ceremony-gates-c34185263808). Review and merge remained outstanding at that receipt.

The 2026-09-12 takeover confirms existing `main` and `egreg-lab` sessions at `/tmp/tmux-1000/default`. The current CLI default socket differs; attach the existing server rather than interpreting the other socket's absence as session loss. Current unqualified `who` is empty, so no new interactive-login receipt is asserted.

## Remaining closure

Lab [tinyland-inc/lab#1595](https://linear.app/tinyland/review/docssting-support-live-migration-and-retire-ceremony-gates-c34185263808) merged through normal protections at 2026-09-13T00:44:10Z, merge commit `1d8079fb0b88082fbd0f846404a5166e19bf1c57`: [tinyland-inc/lab#1595](https://linear.app/tinyland/review/docssting-support-live-migration-and-retire-ceremony-gates-c34185263808). The September repair removes superseded stillness, exclusion and stop-writer prose and its literal test assertions. Runtime continuity and full-state coverage remain distinct from this completed documentation merge.

The September carry has placed eleven additional home trees on `/srv/fast-local` with home symlinks. Recovered Codex history is preserved in a standalone SQLite snapshot under `state/provider-snapshots/neo/20260909T093450Z`. The separately reviewed state_5 insert-only/path-update adapter has now completed live integration; recovered thread-history composition remains offline. The operator authorized treating `ems-jess-dev-wt` as archival payload: its broken `.git` pointer was removed on both hosts, with payload preserved. Live state_5 integration is complete; the recovered thread-history candidate remains preserved offline.

C2 auto-fire is disarmed by `d721a04a` and its amendments; the expired August deadline never triggers a reframe or session shutdown. The obsolete C2 execution blocks and queue sequence have been removed from this description. Prior observations and ratifications remain in comments. [TIN-3080](https://linear.app/tinyland/issue/TIN-3080/relocate-egreg-emacs-daemon-honeysting-new-e)'s eGreg disposition follows its own completion record; historical storage incidents do not impose an unratified avoidance of `/srv/fast-local`.

## Configuration reconciliation receipt

Eight copied configuration links targeted a Neo-only Nix store generation absent on Sting. No corresponding files existed in Sting's active Home Manager generation. Repaired cmux, ghostty, linear-gsuite, the explicitly Neo-named storage registry, and four tinyland/vscode links to their preserved resolved incoming files under `/srv/fast-local/jess/state/config-carry/neo-20260912/resolved`; original link definitions remain in `source-links`. No readable native managed setting was overwritten. The fish 4.3 migration file had an empty `fish_key_bindings`; restored `fish_default_key_bindings`, preserved the original in that same carry namespace, and verified a new interactive fish shell without the warning. Existing shells were not restarted.

The operator is beginning active work on Sting in spear_resumes and eGreg. Those workspaces remain dual-writer protected. `/home/jess` remains the login home; git/Claude/Codex/gstack resolve onto `/srv/fast-local`. `.config` and `.pi` remain on `/home`. Lab [tinyland-inc/lab#1595](https://linear.app/tinyland/review/docssting-support-live-migration-and-retire-ceremony-gates-c34185263808) is now merged through the normal protected process.

## eGreg parity gap — manual comparison

Operator manually fetched spear_resumes before the parity check; matching HEAD there does not prove migration delivery. eGreg was not at parity: Sting main4775fa6 was5 commits behind Neo mainff040f6 and42 behind active3617081, which Sting lacked. Neo lane-docs has1 changed path and lane-graph13, plus main .serena/project.yml. Eight registered Sting worktrees lack index files; three retain README payload and five do not. HEAD-resolution alone was insufficient prior acceptance.

Preserved all Neo eGreg refs in `/srv/fast-local/jess/state/git-carry/neo/eGreg/20260913/neo-egreg.bundle`, SHA256 `24eb80be2550e1f77729fbeabb698bf987e674aa015a2768d5c171de3805ff68`, and imported into separate `refs/carry/neo/20260913/*`. Native Sting HEAD remained4775fa6. This is object/ref custody, not active-checkout parity. All four current Neo eGreg checkouts have additionally been captured using the native Rust Git adapter and imported into neutral carry refs. Real Neo→Sting native transfer verified both bundle hashes: cold transferred 1,788,751 bytes from 1,886,317 source bytes; repeat reused both files with zero source reads or transfer. Current Neo checkout restoration is complete: `eGreg.worktrees/neo-active-20260913` plus `lane-console`, `lane-docs`, and `lane-graph`, all at 36170812ba41427e71614981b86f16d330229b4a. The native d4699b8 mover preserved their branch names and dirty state. Independently compared index-entry hashes and normalized staged/unstaged binary diffs against Neo: all match. All four reverse gitdir pointers verified and roots0700. Existing Sting main remains4775fa6. The eight historical worktrees now have reconstructed committed baselines under the operator's explicit approval. Original payload and administration are preserved under `state/git-carry/sting/eGreg/historical-baselines-20260913`; all eight baseline checks passed, active main and worktree registrations remained unchanged. Unknown original staging was not recovered or claimed recovered.

Remaining portable local-share payload: pnpm was absent on Sting. Preserved 101,585 regular files and 12 links (1,262,474,605 bytes including links) under `state/local-share-carry/neo-20260912/pnpm`, private root0700. This is preserved cache/tool payload, not activation of Darwin executables or Neo Nix-store launchers. TCFS registries list three noncolliding devices, but only Sting's input currently verifies cryptographically. Native self-import validates Sting's configured key and active registry; Neo's incoming registry fails signature verification. Neo's live file and carried copy have identical SHA256 `5390616319deeac2ee7cd47bd9c3c4a6dec121bad943baf94d6afe763e971c4e`, so the defect predates this carry. Signed and GitHub-verified commit `dbf9d26a959c2c12b0cefdcff07491ca25164827` provides a tested candidate-only native import command. Real candidate generation correctly refused; no signature bypass, rekeying, active registry replacement, or identity change occurred. A publication window alone does not resolve an invalid source signature.

`spear_resumes`: both main checkouts clean at148b9b52 after the operator's manual update. Recovered missing Neo branch `jess/tin-3750-hermetic-artifacts` atd052e410 on Sting via create-only ref update; bundle SHA256 `7e21394995e79ca529102dc57bf8029d2f599422b04fc9fa232647f575d8e036` retained in `state/git-carry/neo/spear_resumes/20260913/neo-heads.bundle`. Sting-only dirty `registry-default-20260813` captured by native d4699b8 with filesystem metadata; bundle SHA256 `83b81320764d95964215419cbec621bc71f12f3291fd8544537429d33f212989` retained in `state/git-carry/sting/spear_resumes/20260913/registry-default-capture/capture.bundle` and imported into Neo neutral `refs/carry/sting/20260913/registry-default/*`. Both working checkouts untouched. This repairs observed custody gaps without claiming estate-wide parity.

## Native transfer and provider validation

Native mover commit d4699b8 delivered and restored the four current eGreg worktrees. Four fresh bundles crossed Neo→Sting in8.91s (3,772,926 transferred bytes), warmrepeat0.28s with zero source reads/transfer; all hashes match. Larger sealed23-file corpus Sting→Neo acceptance transferred1,337,244,921bytes in135.69s from an already warmed source store, with zero original-source bytes reread. Repeat0.14s reused23files with zero wire/source bytes; all23SHA256 values match retained source hashes. A registered interruption test resumed after one committed file and completed remainingtwo without source rereads. These are measured directions/corpora, not an rclone comparison or a no-directory-rewalk claim.

Native hydration completed 6,708 files (415,480,447,268 output bytes), with compressed inputs retained and identities validated. The approved live state_5 adapter completed: 1,739 rows inserted, 10,248 paths corrected, zero runtime conflicts. Post-apply validation records 11,235 threads, unchanged schema and 52 migration records, zero foreign-key violations, and quick_check OK. All 114 historical missing-file records retain their original path pairs. Final Neo cutoff: 2026-09-13T01:03:30.434801059Z; later activity is not covered by this cutoff. Source snapshots and pre-apply backup hashes remain verified. Receipts: `/srv/fast-local/jess/state/provider-snapshots/sting/20260913-final-cutoff/`. No database file was replaced and no session stopped. Recovered-history composition remains offline: 266,352 records imported into the candidate, 506,729 existing items preserved, and 438 conflicting/orphan/control cases retained separately.

## Current operator decisions and estate scope

Operator explicitly chose to keep the invalid full Neo registry archived. Sting's active registry is unchanged; a separately recovered older `neo.local` subset verifies under the original signature, and its signed union candidate is retained but not activated. No rekeying or signature bypass is authorized. The later `macbook-neo` entry remains preserved but unverified.

Operator authorized preserving all existing files in the eight older eGreg worktrees and reconstructing their committed baselines. Existing files and administration must be retained before reconstruction; unknown original staging must not be represented as recovered. The four newly restored current Neo worktrees and active Sting main are outside that repair set.

Operator reiterated that eGreg is one of many repositories and full estate migration is required. Per-repository mover acceptance is not estate-wide coverage. Read-only repository/worktree comparison and bounded native batch execution are now in progress. Import-only custody must remain distinct from a usable restored workspace; active destination work must not be overwritten.

## Native estate acceptance — 2026-09-13

Completed and checked on Sting: 13 missing-index repairs, 24 ordinary absent worktrees restored, 1 retained-registration payload recovery ([TIN-1449](https://linear.app/tinyland/issue/TIN-1449/e5-observability-slos-per-tenant-dashboards-ttfch-probe-poison)), and 6 payload-only workspaces reattached. Captured HEADs, semantic indexes and reverse Git pointers were checked; active destination work remains untouched. These match recorded source snapshots, not later Neo commits. The two retained bulkload/DarwinNicUtil indexes recover dated staging, not unknown later staging. Other registered-payload recoveries remain in flight; a resolving HEAD alone is not payload completion.

Signed 562d277 includes configuration-aware standalone restoration, guarded retained-registration recovery and persistence timing instrumentation. 52 scoped tests, formatting, clippy and Linux/Darwin releases passed. Later source changes (streaming Git-object restoration, bounded persistence parallelism and directory durability) await integrated validation. Metadata censuses remain; no never-rewalk claim.

Measured comparison: isolated APFS-cloned 23-file corpus, 242,605,606 source bytes; local copy on Neo, nice19, one repetition per run, OS caches not flushed. Full BLAKE3 and mode/link checks ran outside timing. Instrumented run2: native initial 53,848.545 ms, 226,762,914 transferred content bytes; native resume 4.840 ms, zero source/content bytes. Actual rclone initial 1,082.360 ms, resume 141.069 ms; its byte counters are unmeasured. Native initial is about 49.75 times slower and resume about 29.15 times faster: not an overall performance win or a network benchmark. Chunk persistence measured 5,876 calls and 104.702 seconds summed worker time, including 35.135 seconds file sync and 31.734 seconds directory sync (5,743 each). Worker sums are not additive wall-time shares or isolated causal proof. Receipt: /Users/[host-local user redacted]/git/tummycrypt/.bulkload-bench-real-ee15653/run2-instrumented.log. Run1 remains retained beside it.

Not full-estate completion. Blahaj and some lab/GF restorations remain held on differing common info/exclude policies; no global policy edit occurred. Fresh configuration-aware Legalab and Medical captures completed and were delivered for restoration. Both source-change refusals from the 32-item pass succeeded on one bounded retry. The unchanged 103-item same-HEAD index capture plan is now running; its first seven captures were delivered. Chapel refused with GIT_INVENTORY_MALFORMED and is being investigated separately, not excluded. Original source captures continue without signals.

Recovered history remains offline pending explicit historical-restoration disposition: 3,511 turns and 262,043 items are absent from live history, all associated with currently live state5 thread IDs. No deletion tombstones exist, so first-import history cannot distinguish never-migrated rows from intentionally deleted rows. No history activation, projection-offset changes, database replacement or session stop occurred.

## Outcome

Freeze the v0.2 process-level harness adapter contract and prove it with Codex, Claude, and OpenCode. Control and redacted diagnostics use a versioned JSON-RPC subprocess boundary. There is no C ABI or shared-library SDK.

## Contract

* opaque session and route handles; no token bytes cross the adapter boundary;
* lifecycle: preflight, managed launch, route/lease snapshot, typed transition, repair handoff, teardown;
* exact-model demand and one-alternate outcome vocabulary shared across adapters;
* feature/status discovery is explicit per method; unimplemented methods cannot advertise support;
* local-only redacted events and stable schema versioning;
* adapter-specific auth/provider mechanics stay behind the process boundary.

## Acceptance

1. Checked-in schema and compatibility tests for the new surface version.
2. Codex and Claude managed adapters round-trip lifecycle and redacted status.
3. OpenCode exercises the same contract as the independent conformance adapter.
4. Only the versioned typed scalar extension namespace is tolerated; all other unknown or sensitive fields fail closed, and unsupported capabilities fail explicitly.
5. No C header, shared library, FFI ownership model, or raw credential response is shipped.

Phase-1 PR #475 declares the surface as `planned_unshipped` / `not_implemented`; it does not satisfy adapter round-trip or OpenCode acceptance.

## In scope

* GitHub release assets and checksums/signing inputs.
* Curl installer.
* Binary-only Homebrew formula.
* deb/rpm metadata.
* Nix/source consumption.
* Compatibility `oauth-mux` link beside primary `omux`.
* Service assets, SBOM/provenance, build ID, adapter protocol versions, and supported-platform declarations.

## Excluded

npm remains retired. Do not add `.pkg`, `.dmg`, AppImage, or another unratified lane. Windows managed broker is unsupported; any retained v0.1.15 artifact is compatibility history until the manifest explicitly removes it.

## Acceptance

One `build.zig.zon` version change causes the Zig graph to regenerate/check every supported consumer with no hand-edited drift. Clean-source and installed-artifact proofs agree on version, hashes, signatures, SBOM, provenance, and support matrix.
